• 残すもの: 決済・サブスク証跡、同意記録、無料体験悪用防止キー（再登録時の体験制限）。
• 再登録しても旧アカウントは復元されません。有料サブスクは退会時に解約を試みます。

terms.s1Body: MachineFit provides machine-setting suggestions, workout logging, and community features for reference. It is not medical advice.
terms.s2Body: You must provide accurate information and keep your account secure. Users under 14 may not register.
terms.s3Body: You are responsible for photos, posts, and listings you upload. Unlawful content may be reported and removed.
terms.s4Body: Recommendations and AI insights are estimates. Liability is limited to the extent permitted by law.
terms.s5Body: For terms or service questions, contact the operator through in-app channels.
terms.s6Body: 有料メンバーシップ・無料体験・更新・解約は電子商取引・返金ポリシーおよび決済画面の告知に従います。新規登録時に無料体験が自動付与される場合があります。
terms.s7Body: 退会後はログインできず識別情報は匿名化されます。約30日後に運動記録・投稿・アップロードが削除されます。決済・同意記録は法令により残る場合があります。再登録は新規会員です。
terms.s8Body: アカウント盗用、無断クロール、障害誘発、権利侵害コンテンツ、決済回避を禁じます。
terms.s9Body: UI・推薦ロジックの権利は運営者にあります。ブランド・マシン画像の権利は各権利者にあり、申告があれば削除します。
terms.s10Body: 本規約は大韓民国法に従います。事業者登録情報は確定後にフッターへ記載します。問い合わせ: support@machinefit.app

legal.privacyLead: How we collect and use personal data.

privacy.s1Body: ソーシャルログイン識別子・メール（提供時）、表示名、アバターURL、登録時必須の生年月日（満14歳確認用。住民登録番号は収集しません）、性別・身長・体重・年齢・出生時刻（入力時、占い等）、運動目標、位置（任意）、運動記録、友人・通知・写真・取引・オンラインPT、決済・サブスクのメタデータ（カード番号は決済事業者保管）、アクセスログを処理する場合があります。ジムオーナーが登録する施設会員名簿（氏名・メール・生年月日等）は施設管理用で、満14歳未満の施設会員が含まれることがあります（MachineFitアカウントではありません）。
privacy.s2Body: Authentication, machine recommendations, logging and insights, community/friends, support, and (if consented) marketing notifications.
privacy.s3Body: 退会時はアカウントを無効化し識別情報を匿名化、位置情報とソーシャルログイン連携を削除します。約30日後に運動記録・お気に入り・友人・投稿・写真・取引・オンラインPT・問い合わせ・テンプレート、所有ジムの会員名簿、アップロードファイルを追加削除します。決済・サブスク証跡、同意記録、無料体験悪用防止キーは法令・運営目的により長く保管します。GPS座標は約30日後に市区町村のみ残し、同意・ログインのIP/UAは約1年後に削除・マスクします。
privacy.s4Body: ホスティング（例: Render）、フロント配信（例: GitHub Pages）、DB/ストレージ（例: Supabase）、ソーシャルログイン（Kakao/Google/Apple）、決済代行（Polar等）、任意のエラー監視（Sentry）、メール送信（SMTPまたはResend、設定時）、YouTube埋め込み等で個人データが処理・国外移転される場合があります。
privacy.s5Body: 設定 > 個人情報権利センターで閲覧・同意撤回・JSONダウンロード・退会が可能です。追加の訂正・削除等はサポートへお問い合わせください。
privacy.s6Body: MachineFitアカウント（ソーシャル登録）は満14歳未満を受け付けません。登録時に生年月日から韓国時間の満年齢をサーバーで計算し、14歳未満なら会員レコードを作成しません。チェックだけでは登録できません。ジムオーナーが入力する施設会員の生年月日は施設管理用の例外であり、当該児童のMachineFitアカウント作成はできません。
privacy.s7Title: 7. 安全管理・問い合わせ
privacy.s7Body: アクセス制御・暗号化通信・権限分離などの安全管理措置を適用します。詳細はセキュリティ案内を参照してください。個人情報に関する問い合わせは support@machinefit.app またはアプリ内サポートへ。個人情報保護責任者の氏名・連絡先は事業者登録確定後に本方針へ記載します。
privacy.s8Body: 本方針は2026-08-14から適用されます。変更時はサービス内告知および本ページの改定日でお知らせします。（以前: 2026-08-13）

legal.locationLead: How we process region (city/district) data. We do not collect member GPS.

locationDoc.s1Body: We may process city/district data you select for rankings and gym search. We do not collect, store, or send browser GPS / current-location coordinates.
locationDoc.s2Body: Region is optional in Settings. You can skip it and still use name search and other features.
locationDoc.s3Body: Selected region data is deleted on account deletion or when you clear it. We do not keep member GPS coordinates.
locationDoc.s4Body: We do not sell location data. Hosting providers process it only as needed to run the service.
locationDoc.s5Body: Use in-app Support or the Privacy Rights center for location inquiries.

legal.marketingLead: How we send event, promotion, and product updates when you opt in.

marketingDoc.s1Body: Service news, events, promotions, and personalized offers via push or email.
marketingDoc.s2Body: Marketing consent is optional and does not affect signup or core features.
marketingDoc.s3Body: You can withdraw anytime in Settings → Privacy Rights. We stop marketing messages after withdrawal.
marketingDoc.s4Body: Use in-app Support for marketing consent questions.

legal.commerceLead: 有料サービス（Premium等）の決済・無料体験・解約・返金・クーリングオフに関する案内です。

commerce.s1Body: MachineFit Premium等はPolar等の決済代行で課金される場合があります。オンラインPTの一部はデモクレジットのことがあり、その場合は実カード課金ではありません。
commerce.s2Body: サブスク・決済状態はマイページの課金履歴で確認できます。カード番号は決済事業者に保管され、アプリDBには保存しません。
commerce.s3Body: 新規登録時、運営方針によりPremium無料体験（例: 7日）が自動付与される場合があります。体験後の有料転換・自動更新は登録/決済画面の告知に従い、体験中も解約できます。
commerce.s4Title: 4. 解約・返金・クーリングオフ
commerce.s4Body: マイページから更新を解約できます。デジタル/期間制サービスは提供開始後、電子商取引法等の例外を除きクーリングオフ・返金が制限され、開始済み利用期間の返金は原則不可です。誤課金はお問い合わせへ。
commerce.s5Body: 販売者情報はアプリ下部の事業者表示に従います。未記入項目は届出完了後に更新します。

legal.communityLead: Rules for posts, comments, photos, and listings.

communityDoc.s1Body: Abuse, hate, NSFW, illegal, infringing, or fraudulent content is prohibited. Filters and moderation may apply.
communityDoc.s2Body: Users may report posts/comments/photos/friends/trades and block friends.
communityDoc.s3Body: Authors may delete; admins may hide content. Legal violations may be actioned without prior notice.
communityDoc.s4Body: By uploading, you grant a non-exclusive license needed to operate and display the service. You keep ownership.
communityDoc.s5Body: Sponsored content will be labeled. Paid ad inventory is limited today.

legal.copyrightLead: Rights for machine/brand images, YouTube, and user uploads.

copyright.s1Body: カタログ画像は運営者がアップロードした参考資料です。ライセンス表記を捏造しません。権利が不明な画像は申告があれば直ちに取り下げます。ブランドロゴ・製品写真の権利は各権利者にあります。
copyright.s2Body: Embedded videos are subject to YouTube terms; processing is disclosed in the Privacy Policy.
copyright.s3Body: You must have rights to upload. Unauthorized photos may be reported and removed.
copyright.s4Body: Use Support (copyright) or content report reason copyright.
copyright.s5Body: Each brand name, product name, and trademark is a registered trademark or trademark of its respective owner. MachineFit is an independent service and does not imply affiliation, endorsement, or an official relationship with any manufacturer.
copyright.s6Body: UIは Inter（SIL Open Font License）と Lucide アイコンを使用します。ライセンスファイルのないメーカー実写・ワードマークPNGはカタログに出さず、オリジナルSVGまたはプレースホルダーに置き換えます。

legal.aiLead: Reference-only notices for recommendations, insights, and Online PT.

ai.s1Body: Recommendations, insights, and PT answers are not medical diagnosis and do not replace professionals.
ai.s2Body: AI/algorithm outputs are estimates and may be wrong. Check your condition before training.
ai.s3Body: You are responsible for injuries during training to the extent permitted by law.
ai.s4Body: Trainer answers and automated guidance should be understood separately. Seek a professional if unsure.

legal.securityLead: How MachineFit protects personal data and what users should do.

securityDoc.s1Body: APIs are protected with authentication and role checks. Admin and gym-owner features require elevated permissions.
securityDoc.s2Body: The service is served over HTTPS. Access tokens stay in memory only. Refresh tokens are stored as an HttpOnly cookie on the API host when the browser allows it, and also in sessionStorage as a fallback when GitHub Pages → Render blocks third-party cookies. Closing the tab clears sessionStorage. Social credentials are tokens/links, not local passwords.
securityDoc.s3Body: We may review ops logs and optional monitoring tools for abuse. If a breach is confirmed we act and notify as required by law.
securityDoc.s4Body: Lock your device and sign out on shared devices. Contact support if you notice suspicious access.

legal.illegalUseTitle: 違法利用および関係機関への協力
legal.illegalUseLead: Notice on lawful use of MachineFit and cooperation with authorities when illegal or abusive use is involved.

illegalUseDoc.s1Body: Users must use MachineFit only for lawful purposes under applicable laws and these terms, and must not use the service for illegal acts or to infringe others’ rights.
illegalUseDoc.s2Body: If MachineFit confirms or reasonably suspects illegal or abusive use, it may restrict or suspend the user’s access and, where necessary, retain and review related data.
illegalUseDoc.s3Body: If such conduct appears to violate law or involve crime, MachineFit may report it to the relevant authorities and, within the scope required for investigation, provide materials and other necessary cooperation as permitted by law.
illegalUseDoc.s4Body: Users must comply with applicable laws when using MachineFit. All liability arising from illegal use rests with the user concerned.

peerComparison.definition: Percent change in daily total volume (all machines) from your first workout day to your last in {{period}}.
peerComparison.definitionExample: Example: 800 kg first day → 960 kg last day = +20% growth

peerComparison.peerAvgHint: Average daily volume growth for similar users
peerComparison.interpretAbove: You are growing faster than similar users.
peerComparison.interpretNear: You are growing at a similar pace to peers.
peerComparison.interpretBelow: Growth is slower than peers. Try increasing daily total volume step by step.
peerComparison.interpretUnknown: Log at least 2 workout days to compare growth.

consistency.above: More workout days can help you outgrow similar users.
consistency.near: Workout days are low. Aim for 2–3 logged days per week.
consistency.below: Long gaps slow progress. Restart with a shorter cycle.

intensity.above: Volume is steady but plateauing. Try the next total volume target.
intensity.near: Daily total volume is flat. Add a little weight or sets.
intensity.below: Time to raise intensity. Increase daily total volume gradually.

volume.above: Strong growth. Balance workout days and total volume.
volume.near: Average growth. Try raising daily total volume a bit more.
volume.below: Slower than peers. Increase total volume step by step.

recovery.above: Recent daily volume dropped. Recover, then build back up.
recovery.near: Volume decreased. Resume within a comfortable range.
recovery.below: Your recent training load rose quickly. Consider a lighter week.

maintain.above: Ahead of similar users. Keep your current pace.
maintain.near: Doing well vs average. Avoid big jumps.
maintain.below: Good progress. Focus on the next total volume target.

tips.consistency: Logging on similar weekdays makes daily trends easier to read.
tips.intensity: Track both daily max weight and total volume for balanced progress.
tips.volume: A ~10% daily volume increase is a safe progression.
tips.recovery: Prioritize sleep and protein; focus on volume recovery this week.
tips.maintain: Raise your daily volume target in ~50 kg steps every 2–3 weeks.
tips.plateau: If total volume stalls 2+ weeks, add a machine or an extra set.
tips.lowFrequency: Few workout days in this period. Aim for at least 2 per week.
tips.abovePeer: Growth is above similar users. Watch for overtraining.
tips.belowPeer: To match peers, try increasing daily total volume by 10–15%.

consistency.above: Increasing workout frequency can accelerate growth further.
consistency.near: Workout frequency is low. Aim for 2–3 logged sessions per week.
consistency.below: Long gaps between sessions are slowing progress. Restart with a shorter cycle.

intensity.above: Volume is steady but max weight has plateaued. Try the next target load.
intensity.near: Weight has stalled. Increase load slightly on each set.

volume.above: Growth is strong. Balance load and set count carefully.
volume.near: You are growing at an average pace. Try raising total volume a bit.
volume.below: Growth is below cohort average. Increase sets or load gradually.

recovery.above: Recent volume dropped. Resume after recovery.
recovery.near: Volume decreased recently. Restart within a comfortable range.
recovery.below: Signs of fatigue. Use a lighter recovery week.

maintain.above: You are outpacing similar users. Keep the current pace.
maintain.near: You are ahead of average. Prefer small jumps over big leaps.
maintain.below: Growth is healthy. Focus on the next target weight.

tips.consistency: Logging on the same weekdays makes trends easier to read.
tips.intensity: Train around RPE 7–8 instead of failure every set for sustainable gains.
tips.volume: Adding 2.5 kg per set while keeping set count is a safe progression.
tips.recovery: Prioritize sleep and protein; focus on form over PRs this week.
tips.maintain: Try a 2.5–5 kg increase every 2–3 weeks for progressive overload.
tips.plateau: If weight stalls for 2+ weeks, add one set or shorten rest periods.
tips.lowFrequency: Recent logs are sparse. Target at least twice per week.
tips.abovePeer: You are growing faster than similar users. Watch for overtraining.
tips.belowPeer: To match the cohort average, try raising total volume by 10–15%.
